styling_philosophy: Dark IDE / Code editor aesthetic: solid deep black/zinc canvas (no noisy full-screen gradients), crisp amber-orange forge accent (#FF6B2B / 20 100% 55%), high contrast typography, monospaced details, micro-borders.

layout_and_panels.workspace_structure: 3 resizable columns or responsive flex/grid: Panel 1 (Chat AI + OpenRouter model picker + upload + change summaries '+3/-1' with modal diff view), Panel 2 (File tree explorer + Code editor textarea with line numbers & syntax highlight styling), Panel 3 (Interactive live preview iframe with reload & device toggle buttons)
layout_and_panels.nav_bar: Solid background #0d0d11 with 1px border-b border-border/80, non-transparent, displays 'Forja' brand icon (hammer/anvil fire vibe), active project title, model tag, Clerk user avatar/Google status, and action buttons
layout_and_panels.versions_sheet: Slide-over drawer from right showing timestamped snapshots, prompt triggers, diff stats and 'Restaurar esta versão' action
layout_and_panels.dashboard_grid: Grid of projects with status pills, last modified relative date, quick actions (Renomear, Abrir, Push GitHub, Excluir) and 'Novo Projeto' card

key_components.landing_page: Hero with crisp pitch 'Crie sites e apps completos com sua própria IA OpenRouter', Google/Clerk sign-in button, live simulated IDE demo preview, feature bento cards (Sua API Key, Sem bloqueios, Streaming veloz, Git Push)
key_components.chat_panel: Floating pill for model selection (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, DeepSeek R1, Llama 3.3 via OpenRouter), markdown code responses, streaming typewriter effect, file modification badge pills (+4/-2)
key_components.diff_dialog: Side-by-side or unified green/red diff viewer for modified files with line changes and accept/reject controls
key_components.settings_modal: Input fields for OpenRouter API Key (masked with reveal toggle and validation test button) and GitHub Personal Access Token
key_components.admin_panel: Compact metrics (Total Projetos, Usuários Ativos, Tokens Consumidos, Modelos Ativos), users data table with toggle-block status, daily limit setter, and recent generation logs

motion_and_feedback.file_tree_entry: Staggered fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, y: 4px to 0, duration: 150ms)
motion_and_feedback.streaming_indicator: Subtle pulsing amber-orange dot indicator in chat header
motion_and_feedback.diff_chips: Pop-in bounce animation for '+3 / -1' change badges
motion_and_feedback.transitions: Specific transitions only: 'transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease'. Never apply universal 'transition: all'

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text on dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio; labels in muted-foreground stay clearly readable (#a1a1aa)
accessibility_and_testing.test_attributes: All buttons, inputs, tabs, model selects, project cards, and modals MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='openrouter-api-key-input', data-testid='chat-submit-button', data-testid='new-project-button', data-testid='diff-view-dialog')
accessibility_and_testing.language: Portuguese UI (Português do Brasil): 'Novo Projeto', 'Publicar no GitHub', 'Chave OpenRouter', 'Prévia em Tempo Real', 'Histórico de Versões', 'Salvar Alterações'
